title: Sex differences in rTMS treatment response: A deep learning-based EEG investigation.
summary: Deep-learning EEG classifiers distinguished pre/post-rTMS and response groups in a small MDD cohort; the paper explicitly cautions that classifier performance does not establish that one sex benefits more from treatment.
ai_technology: Methods describe 25 women and 25 men and five EEG classifiers; Results report >91% pre/post classification and a male-responder subgroup result, with class imbalance and explicit limits in the Discussion.
organization: Department of Neurosurgery; Department of Rehabilitation Service
